boundaries.name: rust_plonky2_compiler
boundaries.obligation: Prove actual Rust builder and witness code refines the listed manual definitions, exact wire allocation/assignment/unwrap behavior and final registered circuit; source-line partition is inventory, not compiler certification.

boundaries.name: field_ranges_boolean_u64
boundaries.obligation: Justify CircuitGates from source field constraints: canonical32-bit limbs, boolean prefix/sum field↔Nat lowering, strict u64 comparator, checked two-limb add and no overflow.

boundaries.name: keccak_poseidon_native_encoding
boundaries.obligation: Justify exact Keccak and H1 Poseidon/canonical-byte encoding at listed preimages; any collision-binding premises apply only to two concrete compared inputs, never globally injective finite hashes.

boundaries.name: fixed_recursive_falcon_verifier
boundaries.obligation: Authenticate the supplied fixed aggregate verifier as the intended Falcon circuit; arity73 is not identity. Prove local AggregateContractAt for the exact proof/statement, including key limb provenance and padding.

boundaries.name: indexed_member_distinctness
boundaries.obligation: Justify local visited path insertion contracts at height4, empty root and exact key/value1 arguments. No global Merkle injectivity or security premise is assumed.

boundaries.name: native_projection_and_partial_witness
boundaries.obligation: NativeEnvironment.stateData must project the exact typed revived state, fixed arrays/u8-u16 counts, slot_tree_root computation and checked setters; setAssignments must execute the list in order, stopping on first panic.

boundaries.name: proof_backend
boundaries.obligation: Backend returning a proof is an observation, not an assumed valid Cancel proof. Actual prover/verifier and recursion soundness remain unproved.

boundaries.name: manager_pending_authority_and_replay
boundaries.obligation: MatchesPending must be justified by exact Manager/SettlementVerifier field injection and deployment pins. Generation/cancellation floors are absent from the circuit; replay resistance requires actual L1 history guards.

boundaries.name: fixture_feature_scope
boundaries.obligation: Lines715–953 are cfg(any(test, feature=cancel-close-fixture-bin)) helpers, explicitly untranslated when executable; lines954+ are test-only. No source test/fixture is executed or promoted to a theorem.
